notes.title: Translations now available in Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[i]Lorelai[/i] has been updated to version 1.1.0 today.

This update includes a selection of language translations (subtitles) written by fans of the game/series!

These include:

ːlorumbrellaː French - by Jugdjay
ːlorumbrellaː Italian - by Darth Vader
ːlorumbrellaː German - by PandaManiacLP
ːlorumbrellaː Spanish - by Lux
ːlorumbrellaː Russian - by We're The Demins
ːlorumbrellaː Br Portuguese - by Mechnar
ːlorumbrellaː Polish - by R Michalski
ːlorumbrellaː Turkish - by Monkey
ːlorumbrellaː Czech - by pineapplapierce & LillianMNoir
ːlorumbrellaː Hungarian - by lostprophet.hu

Please note: Achievement names & descriptions (currently in English) will also be updated to these languages in the next 24hrs.

You can still access the previous version (1.0.4 S) on the Beta branch "Bethany" (aka: last good version) - however, save games should carry over without problem to the new version. 

The translation team welcome your feedback! You can leave your reports in this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/593960/discussions/0/1812044473316315099/

Allowing time for some feedback from Steam players, the DRM-Free version (1.1.0 M) will be updated a little later in July, at GOG, Screen 7 via Humble Widget, Humble Store, etc. Thank you for your patience.

Again, we would like to thank all the translators for their work and for allowing even more people to enjoy [i]Lorelai[/i]. And thank YOU for picking up the game and enjoying it - in whatever language!

And if that isn't enough - you can grab the game from Gaben at a great price a little later today in the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b]! 

All the best, Screen 7
and on behalf of Harvester Games and the translation team ːcatbloodː
